questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: In a reversible Carnot cycle operating between hot reservoir $T_H$ and cold reservoir $T_C$, the efficiency $\eta$ is:
questions.explanationEn: For an ideal reversible Carnot engine, $\eta = 1 - \frac{Q_C}{Q_H} = 1 - \frac{T_C}{T_H}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: For blackbody radiation in a cavity of volume $V$ at temperature $T$, how does the total entropy $S$ scale with $T$?
questions.explanationEn: Since $U = a V T^4$ and $dS = dU/T$ at constant $V$, integrating gives $S = \frac{4}{3} a V T^3 \propto T^3$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: The Gibbs paradox (non-extensivity of classical ideal gas entropy upon mixing identical gases) is resolved by dividing the classical $N$-particle partition function by:
questions.explanationEn: Dividing by $N!$ accounts for the quantum indistinguishability of identical particles, yielding the extensive Sackur-Tetrode entropy.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: In the canonical ensemble, the variance of energy fluctuations $\langle (\Delta E)^2 \rangle = \langle E^2 \rangle - \langle E \rangle^2$ is related to the heat capacity $C_V$ by:
questions.explanationEn: $\langle (\Delta E)^2 \rangle = \frac{\partial^2 \ln Z}{\partial \beta^2} = -\frac{\partial \langle E \rangle}{\partial \beta} = k_B T^2 \left(\frac{\partial \langle E \rangle}{\partial T}\right)_V = k_B T^2 C_V$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: In the grand canonical ensemble (fixed $\mu, V, T$), the grand partition function $\mathcal{Z}$ is related to the pressure $P$ and volume $V$ by:
questions.explanationEn: The grand potential is $\Phi_G = -k_B T \ln \mathcal{Z} = -PV$, giving $PV = k_B T \ln \mathcal{Z}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following are EXTENSIVE thermodynamic state variables?
questions.explanationEn: $U$, $S$, and $V$ scale linearly with system size (extensive). Chemical potential $\mu$ (like $T$ and $P$) is intensive (D is false).

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A 3D ideal Fermi gas of electrons has Fermi energy $E_F = 10\text{ eV}$ at $T = 0$. What is the average kinetic energy per electron at $T = 0$ (in eV)?
questions.explanationEn: In 3D, $\langle E \rangle = \frac{3}{5} E_F = 0.6 \times 10 = 6\text{ eV}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A Carnot refrigerator operates between a cold space at $250\text{ K}$ and a hot room at $300\text{ K}$. What is its Coefficient of Performance (COP)?

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: In a cyclic process, a gas absorbs $800\text{ J}$ of heat and rejects $520\text{ J}$ of heat. What is the net work done by the gas per cycle (in Joules)?
questions.explanationEn: For a complete cycle $\Delta U = 0$, so $W = Q_{\text{in}} - Q_{\text{out}} = 800 - 520 = 280\text{ J}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A 3D ideal Bose gas has BEC transition temperature $T_c = 200\text{ nK}$. At temperature $T = 50\text{ nK}$, what fraction of the bosons is in the ground state ($N_0 / N$)? (Round to 3 decimal places.)

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: In a 3D gas of non-interacting relativistic massless fermions ($\epsilon = c p$, spin $1/2$), how does the Fermi energy $E_F$ at $T = 0$ scale with number density $n$?
questions.explanationEn: The Fermi wavevector is always $k_F = (3\pi^2 n)^{1/3}$ (geometry of $k$-space). For ultra-relativistic fermions, $E_F = \hbar c k_F \propto n^{1/3}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: What is the efficiency of an ideal Otto cycle (two adiabats and two isochores) with compression ratio $r = V_1 / V_2$ and adiabatic index $\gamma$?
questions.explanationEn: In an Otto cycle, $\eta = 1 - \frac{T_4 - T_1}{T_3 - T_2} = 1 - \left(\frac{V_2}{V_1}\right)^{\gamma - 1} = 1 - r^{1 - \gamma}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: Two identical blocks of heat capacity $C$ (constant) at initial temperatures $T_1$ and $T_2$ are brought into thermal contact inside an isolated enclosure until they reach equilibrium at $T_f = (T_1 + T_2)/2$. What is the total change in entropy $\Delta S_{\text{total}}$?
questions.explanationEn: $\Delta S = C\ln(T_f/T_1) + C\ln(T_f/T_2) = C\ln\left(\frac{T_f^2}{T_1 T_2}\right) = C\ln\left(\frac{(T_1 + T_2)^2}{4 T_1 T_2}\right) \ge 0$ (by AM-GM).

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A system has three non-degenerate energy levels $0, \epsilon, 2\epsilon$ in thermal equilibrium at temperature $T = 1/(k_B \beta)$. What is the average energy $\langle E \rangle$ in the high-temperature limit ($\beta\epsilon \ll 1$)?
questions.explanationEn: At high $T$, all three levels are equally populated ($1/3$ each), so $\langle E \rangle = \frac{0 + \epsilon + 2\epsilon}{3} = \epsilon$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following statements about the Maxwell-Boltzmann speed distribution $f(v) = 4\pi \left(\frac{m}{2\pi k_B T}\right)^{3/2} v^2 e^{-mv^2/(2k_B T)}$ in 3D are TRUE?
optionsEn: As temperature $T$ increases, the peak shifts to higher speeds and the distribution broadens
The area under $f(v)$ from $v = 0$ to $\infty$ is always equal to 1 regardless of $T$
questions.explanationEn: A, B, and C are exact properties ($\sqrt{2} < \sqrt{8/\pi} < \sqrt{3}$). Because of the $v^2$ spherical phase-space factor, $f(0) = 0$, not maximum (D is false).

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A system of $N$ classical non-interacting particles in 3D has single-particle Hamiltonian $H = c|\mathbf{p}| + \alpha r^2$. By the generalized equipartition theorem, what is the average total energy per particle in units of $k_B T$?
questions.explanationEn: In 3D, $c|\mathbf{p}|$ (homogeneous of degree 1 in 3 momentum components) contributes $3 k_B T$, and $\alpha r^2 = \alpha(x^2 + y^2 + z^2)$ (quadratic in 3 position components) contributes $\frac{3}{2} k_B T$. Total = $3 + 1.5 = 4.5\,k_B T$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: Consider a grand canonical system of fermions on a SINGLE non-degenerate orbital of energy $\epsilon$ at chemical potential $\mu = \epsilon$. What is the grand partition function $\mathcal{Z} = 1 + e^{-\beta(\epsilon - \mu)}$?
questions.explanationEn: When $\epsilon = \mu$, $\mathcal{Z} = 1 + e^0 = 2$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: One mole of an ideal gas expands freely into an evacuated chamber (Joule free expansion), tripling its volume from $V$ to $3V$. Taking $R = 8.314\text{ J/(mol}\cdot\text{K)}$, what is the entropy change $\Delta S$ of the universe (in J/K, rounded to 2 decimal places)?
questions.explanationEn: Since $Q = 0$ for the surroundings ($\Delta S_{\text{surr}} = 0$) and $T$ is unchanged for an ideal gas, $\Delta S_{\text{univ}} = R\ln(3) = 8.314 \times 1.0986 = 9.13\text{ J/K}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: An ideal gas at $P = 2\text{ atm}$ and $V = 5\text{ L}$ expands isobarically to $V = 9\text{ L}$. Taking $1\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 101.3\text{ J}$, what work (in Joules, rounded to 1 decimal place) is done by the gas?
questions.explanationEn: $W = P\Delta V = 2(9 - 5) = 8\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 8 \times 101.3 = 810.4\text{ J}$.

questions.pyqTag: GATE PH Topic • Thermodynamics and Statistical Physics (Set 2)
questions.questionTextEn: A reversible Carnot engine operates between $T_1 = 800\text{ K}$ and $T_2 = 400\text{ K}$, absorbing $1000\text{ J}$ of heat from the hot reservoir per cycle. How much heat (in Joules) is rejected to the cold reservoir per cycle?
